# Offline database fixtures

Synthetic sequence-zero MySQL V10 packets with connection id 42, dummy scramble,
reported versions and instruction-like text; PostgreSQL single-byte S/N signals.
Hex preserves binary framing. No server/client, credentials or private target data.
Fixed-prefix layouts reviewed against the primary sources in docs/database-adapter.md.
Authentication plugin tail is opaque untrusted evidence, never a dispatched operation.
